While researching this lesson, live navigation to docs.chain.link/chainlink-automation/guides/compatible-contracts and docs.chain.link/chainlink-functions (2026-10-05) showed both products now carry explicit deprecation banners (Automation: v1.x deprecated June 30 2026, v2.1 deprecated July 31 2026; Functions: deprecated June 30 2026), with guidance to migrate to the Chainlink Runtime Environment (CRE). Given that, screenshotting either product's live dashboard/UI would risk teaching a deprecated flow as current, so this lesson stays code/steps only, built from the real checkUpkeep/performUpkeep interface still shown in Chainlink's own compatible-contracts guide and the documented Functions request/response architecture. This is a live, verified finding, not an assumption carried over from training data.
